svg.title: Resource groups, tags, action group and budget
svg.desc: Inside your test subscription, rg-azb-core is kept for the whole series and holds the action group ag-azb-email. The monthly budget budget-azb-core sits on the whole subscription, outside any resource group, with four alert thresholds. It calls the action group, which emails you. A practice resource group, rg-azb-practice, has tags and a virtual network and is deleted in Part 2.
svg.text: Only tells you. Nothing is stopped.
rg-azb-practice (Part 2, deleted at the end of Part 2)
